_comment: Where the JavaScript in this directory comes from. Machine-readable so CI can check it:
`npm run check:vendored-parser` hashes these files and the upstream ones and compares.
No hashes are stored. The files ARE the copies, so a stored table would be a third thing
to keep in step. `track` is the branch to compare against - master, the released code;
`develop` there is work in progress. `commit` records which revision was taken.
PROVENANCE.md says what this directory is and why. This file says where it came from.
